headline: Netflix horror game Unhinged uses phone for immersion stars Zoë Kravitz
summary: New Netflix horror game Unhinged uses phone for immersive experience. Starring Zoë Kravitz, Sadie Sink and Troy Baker.
details: Netflix has revealed a new game from the team behind the Oxenfree series that features some well-known actors and some nifty phone-based ideas that aim to make the experience as immersive as possible.

Unhinged stars Zoë Kravitz as Ava, who is trapped in her apartment building as a hurricane batters the area. However, she's not alone. Sadie Sink of Stranger Things fame plays Claire, Ava's friend who lives in a building across the street.

The game features a story mode for those who just want to experience the narrative without having to worry about a timer. In the regular mode, there are events that require you to find a certain object in the room before a timer runs out.
You'll be able to check out Unhinged on Netflix starting June 30. The game requires a Netflix account, your phone and a solid internet connection.

topic: Anthropic Claude AI takes over Slack
headline_marked: Anthropic launches [[Claude Tag]] AI teammate in Slack
headline: Anthropic launches Claude Tag AI teammate in Slack
summary: Claude Tag acts as a persistent AI teammate in Slack, learning and monitoring chats to provide insights and assist with tasks.
details: Anthropic has introduced Claude Tag, an 'always-on Claude' that lives in Slack and acts as an AI teammate. The new feature allows users to tag @Claude to provide insights in chats and assign tasks.
Claude Tag adds a layer of persistent context and memory, enabling it to learn about the work and gather facts from elsewhere in the organization if granted permission to read other channels.

With Claude Tag, everyone in a given Slack channel can access a single Claude identity, allowing anyone to see what Claude has been working on and pick up the conversation from where the last person left off.
System administrators will specify which tools, information, and channels Claude can access, and each Claude identity will stay scoped to whichever channels the admins define.
caption:
Meet Claude Tag, Anthropic's new AI teammate in Slack. What can it do?

Anthropic has introduced Claude Tag, an 'always-on Claude' that lives in Slack and acts as an AI teammate. The new feature allows users to tag @Claude to provide insights in chats and assign tasks.

Claude Tag adds a layer of persistent context and memory, enabling it to learn about the work and gather facts from elsewhere in the organization if granted permission to read other channels.

With Claude Tag, everyone in a given Slack channel can access a single Claude identity, allowing anyone to see what Claude has been working on and pick up the conversation from where the last person left off.

System administrators will specify which tools, information, and channels Claude can access, and each Claude identity will stay scoped to whichever channels the admins define.
